766840103.text: Deal? What deal? Did Paimon miss something important?

766840104.text: The formal phrasing would be: confirming the signature on a memorandum —

766840105.text: The "Joint Training Memorandum on Improving Shooter Effectiveness."

766840106.text: On reflection, recruiting Miss Chasca to the Special Patrol would mean an incalculable loss of talent for her homeland of Natlan — not the wisest move.

766840107.text: And the Special Patrol's clockwork-stable functioning would be unimaginable without Captain Chevreuse's daily command and coordination. Without her, Fontaine would run into no shortage of trouble.

766840109.text: ...We need an unprecedented form of cooperation.

766840110.text: What is this astonishing telepathy going on...

766840113.text: In short, after consulting with Captain Chevreuse, we've decided to start a "long-term study exchange of representatives" within three months.

766840114.text: This plan can strengthen cooperation between the Special Patrol, the Flower-Feather Clan, and the Knights of Favonius — while keeping the burden as low as possible.

766840115.text: ...In the literal sense of those words?

766840116.text: You'll send people back and forth — Flower-Feather Clan warriors stay in Fontaine for a stretch, and Special Patrol fighters head off to Natlan?

766840117.text: Exactly. Though in practice, it's not as simple as just "letting people from each side go live in the other country."

766840118.text: The selection of the representatives, the lodging, the daily curriculum, the simulation training and live drill schedules, the budget arrangements... every detail needs systematic planning.

766840119.text: And we'll be focused on the weak spots — addressing each with its own specific remedy. For instance, the Natlanese warriors don't pay much attention to formation theory, and the Fontainian shooters have almost no live experience with movement-against-movement marksmanship...

766840120.text: ...So we'll have the Natlanese warriors work in disciplined squad-level units; and we'll have the Qucusaurs grab the Special Patrol shooters by the shoulders, fly them low, and have them shoot at intercepting targets.
